# ngwindsongk

> Premium healthy oats, nutritional grain essentials, and Nanacare products for mothers and families. Based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## About ngwindsongk

ngwindsongk is an authentic Kenyan brand offering 100% natural grain staples, premium breakfast cereals, and motherhood essentials with countrywide delivery across Kenya.

### Core Brands & Product Lines
1. **Grainmill** — Premium hearty oats including 100% whole grain Jumbo Rolled Oats, Steel-Cut Oats, finely ground Oat Flour, and Quick Breakfast Oats. Non-GMO, no artificial preservatives.
2. **Nanacare** — Practical baby care and feeding solutions for new mothers, including insulated breastmilk cooler bags, leakproof milk storage cups, nursing covers, and feeding bottles.
3. **Nutmill** — Wholesome roasted nuts, seeds, and healthy pantry picks.

## Content & Resources
- **Recipes**: Step-by-step guides for cooking steel-cut oats, oat flour baking, baby-friendly meals, and breakfast smoothies at https://ngwindsongk.com/recipes
- **Health & Wellness Blog**: Nutritional breakdowns, tips for breastfeeding mothers, and wholesome living at https://ngwindsongk.com/blog

## Delivery & Logistics
- Serves Nairobi County with express 90-minute and standard same-day delivery.
- PickUp Mtaani & countrywide courier options available for all 47 counties in Kenya.
- Accepted Payment: M-Pesa (STK Push / Paybill / Till Number), Card.
- Currency: KES (Kenyan Shillings).
